create_hubert_config: create a HubertConfig instance with default architecture settings for the facebook/hubert-base-ls960 model
customize_hubert_config: customize a HubertConfig instance with modified conv_dim, conv_stride, and conv_kernel for feature encoder layers
validate_hubert_architecture: validate a HubertConfig instance to ensure conv_dim, conv_stride, and conv_kernel lengths match
compute_inputs_to_logits_ratio: compute the inputs_to_logits_ratio property from a HubertConfig to determine the downsampling factor
initialize_hubert_model: initialize a HubertModel instance from a HubertConfig configuration object
